chunks: A man asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: “When should I strike my riding animal beneath me?” He said:
“When it does not walk under you as it walks toward its feeding trough.”

key_terms.تَحْتِي: beneath me, meaning while I am mounted on it

ai.seo_question: When is it permissible to strike a riding animal according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches restraint and mercy in dealing with animals. It indicates that striking a riding animal is only considered when it refuses to move normally, using its eager movement toward food as the measure.
